title: IM60064: Negotiation Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Decision Perspective: Individual decision analysis and behavioural decision
theory, Interactive decision-making – non-cooperative game theory, and joint
decision making – negotiation analysis.
Two-party Distributive Negotiations: Distributed bargaining problem,
reservation price, Dealing with complexities of uncertainty and time, Auctions
and bids.
Two-Party Integrative (Win-Win) Negotiations: Design, evaluation and analysis
of Template-Fote, Scorable negotiation simulation, Non-cooperative
negotiations.
Third-Party Intervention: facilitation and mediation, Arbitration – the mid-mid
and the balanced increment solution, Parallel negotiations.
Multi-Party Negotiation: Group decisions, Consensus, Coalitions, Voting,
Pluralistic parties, Multi-party interventions.
Book
•Raiffa, H. (2005) Negotiation Analysis, Prentice Hall of India Pvt. Ltd, New
Delhi, 2005, ND.
